sheets.title: R O O F R A F T E R / C E I L I N G J O I S T CALCULATION — CEILING JOIST DESIGN (2×8 @ 24" o.c.)

inputs.Location: [16619 Orchard Bend Road, Poway, CA, USA]

results.Note: Utilization slightly exceeds 1.0; deflection remains within acceptable limits for ceiling finishes.

sheets.notes: Sheets 5-9 of the hand report (text.txt lines 4235-4354). ERRORS AS PRINTED: F′ = 1,100 × 1.25 × 1.15 evaluates to 1,581 psi (as on the rafter page), not the printed 1, 881 psi — true utilization 1,818/1,581 = 1.15 (FAIL), and the page's own note says utilization 'slightly exceeds 1.0' while printing 0.98 PASS (1,818/1,881 = 0.97). Printed deflection ≈ 1.20 in does not follow from the printed formula (5·3 lb/in·252⁴/(384·1.6e6·47.6) ≈ 2.07 in → L/122 < L/180). CD = 1.25 applied to ceiling live load (should be 1.0). Drawing S-4 shows '2X10" CEILING JOIST' vs calc 2×8.

observations: Shear wall sheathing mismatch: S-1 wall schedule specifies 5/8" OSB, 10d@4" edge / 10d@12" field, HDU8 hold-downs; all five Tedds walls (W1-W4, IW) use 5/8'' PARTICLEBOARD with 10d common @ 4'' (vs = 610 lb/ft, vw = 855 lb/ft, Ga = 23 kips/in). No HDU8 capacity check; printed hold-down forces are tiny (e.g. W1 T3 = T4 = 0.037 kips, IW 0.006 kips).

Lateral loads are placeholders identical to the 1550 Bluebird set: W = 135 lbs, Eq = 40 lbs, D = 135 lb/ft, Lf = 140 lb/ft, Lr = 180 lb/ft, SDS = 1, Ie = 1.25 on every wall; no seismic/wind base-shear report in the package. Ie = 1.25 is not appropriate for a Risk Category II ADU.

Edition mismatch: drawings 2022 CRC; Tedds sheets NDS 2018 + ASCE 7-16 combos + ACI 318-14; hand rafter/ceiling calc cites '2022 CRC / 2024 NDS'; drawing notes also cite latest UBC, 2019 CALGREEN and the Arizona Green Building Code.

Ceiling joist hand calc is wrong and actually fails: F′ printed 1, 881 psi but 1,100 × 1.25 × 1.15 = 1,581 psi → fb/F′ = 1.15; page says utilization 'slightly exceeds 1.0' yet prints 0.98 PASS; deflection printed ≈ 1.20 in vs ≈ 2.07 in from its own formula (L/122 < L/180).
